name: crystal_stats
description: Compute and inspect workspace cave statistics, temporal genesis, structural totals, physical disk footprints, and quantitative prompt token savings across global cave or filtered search criteria.

query.description: Optional free-text search query to scope statistics calculation

since.description: Filter crystals active on or after ISO-8601 date/datetime or relative expression (today, yesterday, 1d, 7d)

until.description: Filter crystals active on or before ISO-8601 date/datetime or relative expression

has_active_leases.description: Filter crystals holding active transient resource leases

touching_path.description: Match leases or artifacts referencing the specified filesystem path or URI

has_open_tasks.description: Filter crystals with incomplete acceptance criteria

has_lessons.description: Filter crystals with recorded lessons learned

aging.description: Filter by aging category (active, solid, stale)

include_archived.description: Include crystals in cold storage (default: false)

detailed.description: Show detailed per-crystal storage breakdown and ranking (default: false)

json_output.description: Output structured JSON instead of human-readable dashboard table (default: false)
